Thanks Michael — looping in procurement flow owners. Hi Dana, welcome — glad to see the form. A few items from Finance to move this forward: 

1) Mandatory docs: W-9 (received - attached), vendor bank details (for ACH), and a signed Master Services Agreement or MoA. We can provision a vendor code after those are on file.

2) PO and invoice routing: Redwood requires a PO number for any spend over $5k. Invoices should reference the PO in the invoice header and be submitted to invoice@redwood.com or uploaded to our Vendor Portal (link to portal will be provided once vendor code is created).

3) Terms & early-pay: For new suppliers we typically set Net 60 during the initial 90-day onboarding window to align with risk and tax cutoffs. That said, we can run an early-pay pilot at 1.5% / 15 days for the first two invoices once the vendor code is live, subject to Finance sign-off on the bank details and tax docs.

Action items: 
- Dana: please send ACH details and sign the MoA (we'll send a DocuSign link).
- Priyom: please kick off vendor code creation and share the portal invite.
- Michael: confirm whether the customer team needs any special PO labeling (e.g., "ENG-SERVICE-<account>").

Kimberly Park
